name: loopx
description: Durable long-running goals with the official LoopX kernel: evidence, recovery, replanning and governed continuation.

interface.shortDescription: 长期任务、证据验收、断点恢复与受控调度。
interface.longDescription: Connect the official LoopX CLI to Codex projects. Start and resume persistent goals, inspect evidence and user decisions, and follow validated continuation and scheduling contracts. Requires a project runtime; background execution depends on a verified host driver.
defaultPrompt: 用 $loopx start 重构当前模块，先明确验收条件，然后完成第一轮验证。
用 $loopx status 查看当前目标、证据、阻塞与下一步。
用 $loopx resume 接着上一次的任务继续。
